ResStock Measure Documentation: Dual Fuel Heat Pump

item.text: The system switches from the heat pump to the natural gas furnace at **35°F outdoor temperature** (about **1.7°C**). The ResStock 2025 Release 1 report explicitly sets this value in Section 1.2.1.5, “Backup System and Switchover Temperature,” on printed page 5. [Read the report](https://docs.nlr.gov/docs/fy26osti/96414.pdf#page=13).
